players.name: Avery Rivera
players.bio: The engine. Sets the pace, finds the corner shooter, and never lets a possession die quietly.

players.name: Daniel Okafor
players.bio: Club captain and the best catch-and-shoot threat on the roster. Two-time all-league selection.

players.name: Marcus Lee
players.bio: Long, disruptive, and the first name on the scouting report. Lives at the rim on the break.

players.name: Tobias Grant
players.bio: Joined through open tryouts and made the rotation by November. Fearless in transition.

players.name: Elias Haddad
players.bio: Screens, rebounds, talks. The club's unofficial defensive coordinator on the floor.

players.name: Noah Bennett
players.bio: Anchors the paint and finishes everything within three feet. League blocks leader, 2024.

players.name: Kenji Watanabe
players.bio: Movement shooter. Runs off screens like it is a full-time job, because for him it is.

players.name: Samuel Achebe
players.bio: Raw, relentless, and improving every week. The development squad's leading scorer.

players.name: Luca Ferretti
players.bio: Does the unglamorous work: cuts, closeouts, extra passes. Coaches' pick three years running.

players.name: Isaiah Brooks
players.bio: Back for a fifth year while finishing a master's. Club record holder for career threes.

players.name: Omar Haddad
players.bio: Rim protection and a surprisingly soft touch. Learned the game from his older brother Elias.

players.name: Peter Nowak
players.bio: Stretch four with a quick release. Joined the club after two years on the intramural circuit.

staff.name: Dana Whitfield
staff.detail: Eleven seasons with the club, two national semi-final runs.

staff.name: Ray Mensah
staff.detail: Runs the development squad and the Saturday open gym.

staff.name: Priya Shah
staff.detail: Fixtures, travel, kit — everything that makes game day happen.

staff.name: Dr. Elena Rossi
staff.detail: Injury prevention and return-to-play programs for both squads.
